correctness.rationale: Complete reset regeneration makes the stationary backward reset age Exp(r), independent of the newly sampled holding time W; a non-atomic jump law ensures X=0 iff no spatial jump after latest reset. Thus m=r*mu_r. Partitioning whether a new reset occurred during lag t gives E[I0 It]=m²+(1-m)r integral_t∞ e^-ru Psi(u)du, hence R(t)=tail/mu_r. Differentiation gives r=-mR'(0+) and Psi(t)=e^{rt}R'(t)/R'(0+). Tonelli and gamma-integral asymptotics yield all five Lomax regimes with the stated constants. Independent exponential and Lomax integral calculations checked 18 covariance and 15 survival reconstruction cases. No assumption of finite unreset waiting-time mean is needed.
residual_risks: Inference uses exact population derivatives/correlation; non-atomic jumps, full renewal-clock resetting, complete stationary observations are essential. Simulation alone is not an inverse-identification theorem.
